test-readout reads a test against the goal picked before it:

- New goal "prove it's not worse": ship B when the low end of the range stays above the margin you set (e.g. −5%), otherwise "maybe worse" with how much.
- Tests decided on paid conversion or trial starts are read on that metric, with money per person as a guardrail. Switching metrics after seeing the data is flagged as a trap.

One zip per skill below.
